source.implements: Remove: the list leaves the phone (the kept export, the list, its per-battle ticks and its Phase checklist boxes), the app goes to the home screen

Phase checklist: the triggered (ckTriggered) army and detachment rules, the options of a triggered rule (and an option with a trigger of its own; unless a unit of the list has it as an ability: listed as theirs) and the triggered abilities of the list (the same one on several units one line), by data.js CHECKLIST (verify/derive.js): To do now in each phase and turn its text says it is triggered (07.02: the phases; either turn: both), or under the moment it opens with (Start of the (first) battle round, End of your opponent's turn); Active now where its effect is used and it is not triggered; once-per-battle ones (perBattle; Kindred Sorcery's options each) under Once per battle, from where they are triggered, with the Overview's boxes; each line names its unit or source and opens the full text; a rule another rule of the list gives to units by keyword (g) says which and to whom; what a listed one puts in force from a rule of the list (f: "Riled up (War Cry) · Waaagh!", opening that rule) under Active now where its entry says, or When unclear; inert rules and abilities the list cannot use are listed, marked; triggered ones the table cannot place under When unclear, those with no phase under No phase; no stratagems; each section a fold (closed until opened, kept for the session), its line counting each part; a box per line per section, kept per list; Reset clears them (with Undo), not the once-per-battle ones

judgement.code: const ckTriggered = (e, x) => !!(e.t || e.at) || [x.text, x.tag].some(t => { const p = String(t || '').replace(/\*\*|~~/g, ''); return CK_LIMIT.test(p) || CK_ACT.test(p) || CK_MAKE.test(p) || CK_ROLL.test(p); });

source.implements: which rules and abilities the Phase checklist lists ("triggered"; always-on ones are on the datasheets): the CHECKLIST entry names when (t or at, from verify/derive.js), or the words or tag limit its uses (once/twice/three times per battle, battle round, turn or phase), have the player act (you can use this ability / can use it / this part / this Enhancement, you can select or choose, select or choose one… (not after "cannot"/"not"), when …, you can … other than a re-roll, can make a named move or action: "can make a Warpmeld Sacrifice", a choice of alternatives: a "- Or:" line), or roll dice or take a test when something happens (roll one/two/a/an/N/up to…, not a re-roll; take a … test)

an option of a rule or ability on the Phase checklist: its own trigger (and where it is used); with none, where its effect is used (chosen when its rule is triggered: a once-per-battle one is listed there); with neither, its rule's trigger; not derivable: When unclear

data.js CHECKLIST (verify/derive.js --write), the Phase checklist table: per rule and ability, from its text without its options (withoutOptions): t the phases its text names (table 1's trigger) less those only the moment it opens with gives (Start of the battle round: not also the Command phase), at that moment, u where its effect is used (table 1's used-in); none: positively no phase (pre-battle); x: not derivable (nothing guessed); per option (optionsOf) its own trigger only when it names one, where it is used, x when it has neither and no trigger of its rule; g: an ability it gives units by keyword (grantsIn: to, the option, while); the same words on several units must give one entry, else x

what a triggered rule or ability puts in force from a rule defined elsewhere (CHECKLIST f, shown "Riled up (War Cry) · Waaagh!" under Active now): a bold term that is an army or detachment rule of its faction by name or alias, made a state of units by "is/are/be/become(s)" in a clause with no if/while/unless/when before it; its phases from coverOf on the duration in the same sentence

the phases a duration covers from where the text is triggered, in the order of a turn and the next (Core Rules 07): end of the phase: that phase; of the turn / this turn: the rest of that turn; of the next turn: the rest of that turn and the whole next one; until the start of your next turn or Command phase: the rest of that turn, and the opponent's turn after one of yours; end of the battle: every phase; end of the battle round: every phase only from the start of the battle round; a trigger at the start of the battle round counts as each player's Command phase, at the end of your opponent's turn as before your turn; anything else x (When unclear)

judgement.code: const withoutOptions = (text, table) => { const t = rulesText(text); return optionsOf(t, table).reduce((s2, o) => s2.replace(o.text, ''), t); };

source.implements: a rule's or ability's own words for the Phase checklist table: its text without its italic notes and without the text of each of its options (each option has its own entry)

judgement.code: const ckStored = (e, x) => e.x && (phasesOf(x).length || x.at) ? Object.assign({}, e, { x:0, at:x.at, t:phasesOf(x).map(p => p + ':' + phTurn(x, p)).join(',') }) : e;

source.implements: a rule or ability the derived table cannot place (x) but data.js has a phase tag for (ph, turn, at): listed where the tag says it triggers (the row's own timing), as To do now
